title: Blackouts: The Role of India’s Wholesale Electricity Market
title_zh: 停电：印度电力批发市场的作用
title_primary: 停电：印度电力批发市场的作用
title_secondary: Blackouts: The Role of India’s Wholesale Electricity Market
authors: Jha, Akshaya, Preonas, Louis, Burlig, Fiona
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Electricity blackouts impose substantial costs in developing countries. We advance a new explanation for their prevalence in India: utilities’ wholesale electricity demand is downward-sloping. We construct a novel dataset on India’s wholesale electricity sector. Instrumenting for average variable cost with plausibly exogenous power plant equipment outages, we estimate a wholesale demand elasticity of −0.49. Voltage monitoring data confirm that equipment outages drive blackouts. Increases in procurement costs therefore reduce the quantity of electricity delivered to end-use consumers. Our counterfactual simulations suggest that lowering wholesale electricity costs could eliminate blackouts for millions of Indian households.
abstract_zh: 电力停电在发展中国家造成了巨大成本。我们为印度停电普遍存在提出了一种新的解释：公用事业部门的批发电需求呈向下倾斜趋势。我们构建了一个关于印度批发电部门的新数据集。利用看似外生的电厂设备故障作为平均可变成本的工具变量，我们估计出批发电需求弹性为-0.49。电压监测数据证实，设备故障导致了停电。因此，采购成本的增加会减少向终端用户输送的电量。我们的反事实模拟表明，降低批发电成本可能为印度数百万家庭消除停电现象。

title: Household Beliefs about Fiscal Dominance
title_zh: 家庭对财政主导地位的信念
title_primary: 家庭对财政主导地位的信念
title_secondary: Household Beliefs about Fiscal Dominance
authors: Philippe Andrade, Erwan Gautier, Eric Mengus, Emanuel Moench, Tobias Schmidt
official: 官方在线 2025-01-16 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study beliefs about fiscal dominance in a survey of German households. We first use a randomized controlled trial to identify how fiscal news impact individual debt-to-GDP and inflation expectations. We document that the link between debt and inflation crucially depends on individuals’ views about the fiscal space. News leading individuals to expect higher debt-to-GDP ratios make them more likely to revise upward their inflation expectations. These average effects are due to individuals who think that fiscal resources are more stretched than others. In contrast, individuals who think there is fiscal space do not associate debt with inflation. We then rationalize these results in a New Keynesian model where agents have heterogeneous beliefs about the fiscal space. We show that the heterogeneity of beliefs implies a policy tradeoff for the central bank. Agents who expect fiscal dominance in the future exert upward pressure on inflation. An active central bank may choose to partially tolerate this higher inflation due to the real costs of completely stabilizing prices.
abstract_zh: 我们在一项针对德国家庭的调查中研究了关于财政主导地位的信念。首先，我们通过随机对照试验来识别财政新闻如何影响个人对债务占GDP比率及通胀预期的看法。我们记录了债务与通胀之间的联系，这一联系关键取决于个人对财政空间的看法。那些导致个人预期债务占GDP比率上升的新闻，使他们更可能上调通胀预期。这些平均效应源于那些认为财政资源比其他人更为紧张的个人。相反，认为存在财政空间的个人则不会将债务与通胀联系起来。随后，我们在一个新型凯恩斯模型中合理化这些结果，该模型中代理人对财政空间持有异质性信念。我们表明，信念的异质性意味着中央银行面临政策权衡。预期未来财政主导地位的代理人会对通胀产生上行压力。一个积极的中央银行可能因完全稳定物价的实际成本而选择部分容忍这种较高的通胀。

title: Discretionary Announcement Timing and Stock Returns
title_zh: 自主公告时机与股票收益
title_primary: 自主公告时机与股票收益
title_secondary: Discretionary Announcement Timing and Stock Returns
authors: KERRY BACK, BRUCE I. CARLIN, SEYED M. KAZEMPOUR, CHLOE L. XIE
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Discretionary announcement timing generates high conditional risk premia of stock returns and a pattern of negative drifts followed by positive jumps. Average announcement returns are much larger than unconditional risk premia. Capital Asset Pricing Model alphas turn negative when conditioning on nondisclosure because betas rise faster than risk premia prior to disclosures, but average announcement returns may appear to be too large relative to market risk when betas are estimated from past returns. The effects are amplified when multiple firms exercise discretion over the timing of correlated announcements. We present evidence that firms time earnings announcements in a manner consistent with our model.
abstract_zh: 自主择时公告会产生股票回报的高条件风险溢价，以及负漂移后跟随正跳变的模式。平均公告回报远大于无条件风险溢价。当以未披露为条件时，资本资产定价模型阿尔法值转为负值，因为披露前贝塔值上升速度快于风险溢价，但若贝塔值基于历史回报估计，平均公告回报相对于市场风险可能显得过大。当多家企业对相关公告的时机行使自主权时，这些效应会被放大。我们提供的证据表明，企业选择盈利公告时机的行为与我们的模型一致。

title: The climate and adaptation spatial general equilibrium model (OECD-CASGEM): The macroeconomic cost of climate change
title_zh: 气候与适应空间一般均衡模型（OECD-CASGEM）：气候变化的宏观经济成本
title_primary: 气候与适应空间一般均衡模型（OECD-CASGEM）：气候变化的宏观经济成本
title_secondary: The climate and adaptation spatial general equilibrium model (OECD-CASGEM): The macroeconomic cost of climate change
authors: Diogo Baptista & Hélia Costa & Filiz Unsal
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a micro-based, bottom-up approach to quantify the macroeconomic costs of climate change. It combines empirically estimated local climate damages with a global spatial general equilibrium model: the Climate and Adaptation Spatial General Equilibrium Model (OECD-CASGEM). The model links location-specific climate hazards to economy-wide outcomes through trade, migration, production networks, and factor adjustments, capturing the role of spatial and economic adjustments as adaptation shaping aggregate and regional losses. Estimated global GDP per capita losses amount to 3% by 2050 and 6.3% by 2100 under a current-policy scenario (SSP2-4.5) and to 6% and 18%, respectively, under a high-emission scenario (SSP5-8.5), with large associated uncertainty. Losses are highly uneven across regions and are larger in lower-latitude countries and those historically more exposed to climate hazards. Counterfactual simulations show that trade linkages, migration and production networks can dampen or amplify aggregate losses depending on countries’ exposure, economic structure and position in global networks. Spatial mechanisms, in particular, reduce cross-regional dispersion in impacts, effectively operating as a form of implicit loss-sharing across locations.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种基于微观数据的自下而上方法，用以量化气候变化带来的宏观经济成本。该方法将经验估计的局部气候损害与全球空间一般均衡模型——气候与适应空间一般均衡模型（OECD-CASGEM）相结合。该模型通过贸易、移民、生产网络及要素调整，将特定地点的气候灾害与经济整体结果相连接，捕捉了作为适应机制的空间与经济调整在塑造总体及区域损失中的作用。在当前政策情景（SSP2-4.5）下，估计的全球人均GDP损失到2050年为3%，到2100年为6.3%；而在高排放情景（SSP5-8.5）下，相应损失分别为6%和18%，且伴随较大的不确定性。损失在区域间高度不均，低纬度国家及历史上更易受气候灾害影响的国家损失更大。反事实模拟显示，贸易联系、移民及生产网络可能根据各国的暴露程度、经济结构及在全球网络中的位置，放大或缓解总体损失。空间机制尤其能降低跨区域影响的离散程度，实际上起到了跨地点隐性损失分担的作用。

title: Mental Health Care Access in Rural Communities Amid the Expansion of Telehealth
title_zh: 远程医疗扩展背景下农村社区心理健康服务的可及性
title_primary: 远程医疗扩展背景下农村社区心理健康服务的可及性
title_secondary: Mental Health Care Access in Rural Communities Amid the Expansion of Telehealth
authors: Gruber, Anja, Van Sandt, Anders, Loveridge, Scott, Carpenter, Craig
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Compared to metropolitan residents, rural residents face a disparity in access to local mental health providers that is even larger than for other health care services. Telehealth appears to be a natural solution to this issue: Patients should be able to more easily access providers from metro areas, reducing disparities in access to mental health care. In this paper, we consider the flip side of this argument, which has not yet received enough attention. Mental health providers, especially in areas where demand for their services exceeds supply, become more easily able to access patients and therefore may become more selective. We show evidence that access to telehealth services is 8-9 percentage points lower for non-metro residents, even after accounting for potential differences in stigma and internet access. We also show that self-payment is a significant predictor of telehealth utilization in mental health and provide suggestive evidence that the increase of telehealth in mental health treatments has coincided with reduced access to mental health care for publicly insured patients, despite growth in provider numbers across counties. We caution that expansions in telehealth need to be combined with policies to promote equitable reimbursement and reduce barriers for independent providers to bill public and private insurance.
abstract_zh: 与城市居民相比，农村居民在获取本地心理健康服务提供者方面面临更大差距，这一差距甚至超过其他医疗保健服务。远程医疗似乎是解决这一问题的自然方案：患者应能更容易地接触到城市地区的服务提供者，从而缩小心理健康护理获取方面的差距。本文探讨了这一论点的另一面，而这一面尚未得到充分关注。心理健康服务提供者，尤其是在服务需求超过供给的地区，更容易接触到患者，因此可能变得更加挑剔。我们提供的证据表明，即使考虑了污名化和互联网接入方面的潜在差异，非城市居民获得远程医疗服务的可能性仍低8至9个百分点。我们还发现，自费支付是心理健康领域远程医疗使用的重要预测因素，并提供了初步证据表明，心理健康治疗中远程医疗的增加与公共保险患者获取心理健康护理机会的减少同时发生，尽管各县服务提供者数量有所增长。我们提醒，远程医疗的扩展需与促进公平报销的政策相结合，并减少独立服务提供者向公共和私人保险收费的障碍。

title: Microcredit Made to Measure: Experimental Evidence from Rural Morocco
title_zh: 量身定制的微型信贷：来自摩洛哥农村的实验证据
title_primary: 量身定制的微型信贷：来自摩洛哥农村的实验证据
title_secondary: Microcredit Made to Measure: Experimental Evidence from Rural Morocco
authors: Bruno Crepón, Ralph De Haas, Tim Deisemann, Florencia Devoto, William Parienté
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does matching loan repayments to expected cash flows raise take-up and the welfare impact of microcredit? We test this in a randomized controlled trial with Morocco`s largest microfinance institution. The experiment introduces two new individual-liability loan products: a contract with a five-month principal grace period and a tailored contract with installments matched to expected revenues. Over 3,000 applicants are randomly assigned to an offer of one of the two new contracts or the standard loan. The new contracts attract distinct borrowers: agricultural households take up the grace-period loan, while entrepreneurs operating smaller, more capital-constrained businesses choose the tailored schedule. Most tailored-loan borrowers front-load their repayments, suggesting that demand for flexibility reflects cost minimization, not only liquidity management. The tailored loan raises sales and profits via non-agricultural business expansion and labor reallocation to self-employment. The grace-period loan shows similar but statistically insignificant effects. Neither product worsens repayment performance. We find no effects on investment or consumption. In a second stage, we randomize contract-specific information campaigns across 440 villages. Despite shifting stated preferences toward the advertised products, the campaigns do not raise take-up, consistent with supply-side frictions and a challenging macroeconomic environment.
abstract_zh: 将贷款还款与预期现金流相匹配是否能提高小额信贷的采纳率及其福利影响？我们通过与摩洛哥最大的小额信贷机构进行随机对照试验来检验这一问题。实验中引入了两种新的个人责任贷款产品：一种包含五个月本金宽限期的合同，以及一种还款计划与预期收入相匹配的定制合同。超过3000名申请者被随机分配至两种新合同之一或标准贷款的报价中。新合同吸引了不同类型的借款人：农业家庭选择宽限期贷款，而经营规模较小、资本受限企业的创业者则倾向于定制还款计划。大多数定制贷款借款者选择提前还款，这表明对灵活性的需求反映了成本最小化，而不仅仅是流动性管理。定制贷款通过非农业业务扩张和劳动力向自雇就业的重新配置，提高了销售额和利润。宽限期贷款显示出相似但统计上不显著的效果。两种产品均未恶化还款表现。我们未发现对投资或消费的影响。在第二阶段，我们在440个村庄中随机分配了针对特定合同的信息宣传活动。尽管这些活动将陈述偏好转向了广告宣传的产品，但并未提高采纳率，这与供给侧摩擦及充满挑战的宏观经济环境相一致。

title: Differential Land Efficiency and the Environmental Consequences of Agricultural Productivity Growth
title_zh: 土地效率差异与农业生产率增长的环境后果
title_primary: 土地效率差异与农业生产率增长的环境后果
title_secondary: Differential Land Efficiency and the Environmental Consequences of Agricultural Productivity Growth
authors: Tiago Cavalcanti, Kilian Kamkar, Toke S. Aidt, Facundo Albornoz-Crespo, Esther Hauk 等
official: 官方在线 2026-02-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a parsimonious framework in which land differs in agricultural efficiency across alternative expansion margins, showing that productivity gains translate into deforestation only when forests constitute the most cost-effective source of additional effective land. We test this prediction using a quasi-experimental design based on Tanzania’s National Agricultural Input Voucher Scheme (NAIVS), which promoted modern seed and fertilizer adoption. Combining high-resolution satellite data on forest loss with spatial data on soil nitrogen to proxy relative suitability, we find that the program increased deforestation only in villages where vacant land was substantially less productive than forest land. Our results highlight the central role of land quality heterogeneity in shaping the environmental consequences of agricultural productivity growth, offer a complementary explanation for land-sparing versus expansionary outcomes, and point to a role for directed agricultural innovation in mitigating deforestation without constraining productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约的分析框架，其中土地在不同扩张边际上的农业效率存在差异，表明只有当森林构成额外有效土地最具成本效益的来源时，生产率提升才会转化为森林砍伐。我们利用基于坦桑尼亚国家农业投入品代金券计划（NAIVS）的准实验设计来检验这一预测，该计划促进了现代种子和化肥的采用。结合高分辨率卫星森林损失数据与土壤氮空间数据以代理相对适宜性，我们发现该计划仅在闲置土地生产力显著低于森林土地的村庄中增加了森林砍伐。我们的结果凸显了土地质量异质性在塑造农业生产率增长环境后果中的核心作用，为土地节约与扩张性结果提供了补充性解释，并指出了定向农业创新在缓解森林砍伐的同时不制约生产率增长的潜在作用。

title: Why Europe's banks stay home: Regulatory fragmentation and the cost of an incomplete banking union
title_zh: 欧洲银行留守本土的原因：监管碎片化与不完整银行联盟的成本
title_primary: 欧洲银行留守本土的原因：监管碎片化与不完整银行联盟的成本
title_secondary: Why Europe's banks stay home: Regulatory fragmentation and the cost of an incomplete banking union
authors: Damien Capelle, Adriano Fernandes, Jan Jakob Krüger, Peter McAdam
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Despite major institutional reforms, the European Banking Union remains incomplete. Banking markets remain fragmented along national lines, which constrains Europe’s growth potential. This column uses loan-level data from the European credit registry combined with the bank group structure dataset to quantify where the barriers to cross-border lending lie, what role cross-country regulatory differences play, and how much output Europe forgoes as a result. It finds that the binding constraints sit on the extensive margin, that is, forming relationships and entering markets, that they are closely related to regulatory fragmentation, and that lifting them may deliver sizeable economic gains.
abstract_zh: 尽管经历了重大制度改革，欧洲银行业联盟仍不完善。银行业市场仍沿国界分割，这制约了欧洲的增长潜力。本专栏利用欧洲信贷登记机构的贷款级数据，结合银行集团结构数据集，量化了跨境贷款的障碍所在、跨国监管差异的作用，以及由此导致的欧洲产出损失。研究发现，约束性障碍主要存在于广延边际层面，即建立关系和进入市场方面，这些障碍与监管碎片化密切相关，而消除这些障碍可能带来可观的经济收益。

title: Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
title_zh: 平台控制下的搜索与注意力分配扭曲
title_primary: 平台控制下的搜索与注意力分配扭曲
title_secondary: Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
authors: Cai, Xiaoming (Peking University HSBC Business School), Gautier, Pieter (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam), Wolthoff, Ronald (University of Toronto)
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices Ã la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them – its saturation point – and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point.. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——一类是利基卖家，其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐；另一类是大众市场卖家，其商品受所有买家青睐。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异导致了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在略超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点（即饱和点）之上，并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于受限制的买家而言，两个平台的运营均超过了饱和点。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。

abstract: We introduce a new type of games, called “opportunity-hunting games,” in which two players compete to discover an uncertain event (“opportunity”) that occurs at an unobserved and random point in time. Players can inspect whether the event has already occurred again and again, but each inspection is costly. Varying the parameters of the model spans the range from games where competition between the players to be the first to identify the opportunity is the dominant force, to games in which free riding on the other player’s effort is the dominant force. We characterize the game’s unique symmetric Markov perfect equilibrium. (JEL C72, C73)

abstract: Public programs that provide benefits through private markets contend with strategic firm behavior. We study this dynamic in Medicare Part D. The Affordable Care Act closed a coverage gap in Part D by mandating drug manufacturers cover 50% of branded drug costs in the gap. Beneficiaries became 5 percentage points less likely to forgo prescriptions upon reaching the gap. However, manufacturers' response led to 21% higher drug prices, partially offsetting the insurance expansion. The closure was intended to be a $100 transfer to beneficiaries financed by manufacturers, but instead resulted in a $55 transfer to beneficiaries financed by the government.

title: Can rapid rental assistance avert evictions? Evidence from administrative delays
title_zh: 快速租金援助能否避免驱逐？来自行政延迟的证据

title_secondary: Can rapid rental assistance avert evictions? Evidence from administrative delays
authors: Mason Alexander, Matthew Freedman, Stephanie Casey Pierce
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many communities in the U.S. have programs that make financial assistance available to families with low incomes who are struggling to pay rent. In this paper, we examine the average and distributional impacts of reducing wait times for emergency housing assistance on evictions. Taking advantage of administrative data from Franklin County, Ohio and exploiting exogenous changes in application processing times in two complementary empirical approaches, we find that each additional week of delay in receiving assistance increases the probability of an eviction filing within 12 months by 19–29%. A substantial share of the additional filings result in judgments against tenants. Our results have important implications for the design and implementation of emergency rental assistance programs. More broadly, our findings speak to the downstream impacts of passive compliance costs in social safety net programs.
abstract_zh: 美国许多社区设有项目，为难以支付租金的低收入家庭提供经济援助。本文研究了缩短紧急住房援助等待时间对驱逐事件的平均影响及分布效应。利用俄亥俄州富兰克林县的行政数据，并借助两种互补实证方法中申请处理时间的外生变化，我们发现：援助每延迟一周，12个月内收到驱逐申请的概率将增加19%至29%。这些额外申请中有相当比例最终导致对租户不利的判决。我们的研究结果对紧急租金援助项目的设计与实施具有重要启示。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了社会安全网项目中被动合规成本的后续影响。

title: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
title_zh: HANK经济中的自我实现波动
title_primary: HANK经济中的自我实现波动
title_secondary: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
authors: Sushant Acharya, Jess Benhabib
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)
abstract_zh: 本文证明，在具有反周期风险特征的异质性主体新凯恩斯（HANK）经济体中，自然利率具有内生性并与产出协同变动，导致经济易受自我实现波动的影响。与代表性主体新凯恩斯模型不同，若风险仅呈现轻微反周期特征，泰勒原理不足以确保HANK经济中均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化的反应强度如何，均存在多重有界均衡。要使积极的货币政策消除自我实现波动，必须稳定内生性自然利率波动。此外，被动的货币政策与积极的财政政策组合亦可消除均衡多重性。（JEL分类号：E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）

authors: Hung Le, Otto Toivanen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Price regulation may have unintended consequences, such as facilitating collusion or softening actual price competition by causing a reduction in the number of active firms. Observing different firms hav- ing a monopoly position in parts of a market may be the result of either intense post-entry competition and non-cooperative entry decisions, or collusive entry. This phenomenon and large price differences per pill within a market are widespread in the Swedish generic pharmaceutical market where price regulation through monthly auctions for each active ingredient–dosage form–strength–package size combination channels a large part of demand to the winner within each such substitution group. 22% of the markets are potentially collusive in having at least two firms as monopolies for different substi- tution groups at least some of the time and prices per pill in such markets are on average significantly higher. We take a structural model tailored to the Swedish circumstances to data on two markets. In one market, the entry patterns (monopoly package sizes) are suggestive of actual, in the other of attempted, collusion. Our counterfactual analysis where we induce substitution across package sizes yield savings of >50% in the first market, but lead to a modest expenditure increase in the other because intensified post-entry competition induces exit.
abstract_zh: 价格管制可能产生非预期后果，例如通过减少活跃企业数量来促进合谋或弱化实际价格竞争。观察到不同企业在市场不同部分拥有垄断地位，既可能是激烈进入后竞争与非合作进入决策的结果，也可能是合谋性进入所致。这一现象及市场内每片药物价格差异巨大的情况，在瑞典仿制药市场中普遍存在——该市场通过每月针对每种活性成分-剂型-规格-包装规格组合的拍卖实施价格管制，将大部分需求引导至各替代组内的中标企业。22%的市场存在潜在合谋特征：至少有两家企业在不同替代组中至少部分时段形成垄断，此类市场的每片药物价格平均显著更高。我们针对瑞典市场特征构建结构模型，并将其应用于两个市场的数据。其中一个市场的进入模式（垄断包装规格）暗示实际合谋，另一个市场则显示合谋企图。反事实分析表明，通过诱导跨包装规格替代，第一个市场可节省超过50%的费用，但第二个市场因进入后竞争加剧导致企业退出，反而使支出小幅增加。

authors: Roberto Gómez-Cram, Howard Kung, Hanno Lustig, David Zeke
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the equilibrium effects of financial repression on government funding costs in an endowment economy with limited asset market participation. We show how a broad set of repression policies operates through a wedge in the Euler equation responsive to government size or by affecting fiscal redistribution between agents. Repression intensity is captured by a policy feedback rule that depends positively on net government spending. When fiscal policy is profligate and monetary policy accommodates, we show that such a repression policy raises bond values, reduces the inflationary cost of unfunded fiscal expansions, and lowers bond risk premia. Repression is not a free lunch for bondholders---they pay a lower inflation tax but also earn lower future real returns. When monetary policy does not accommodate fiscal policy, repression can provide stopgap funding for deficits, allowing the central bank to retain control over inflation while making government debt a hedge for fiscal inflation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限资产市场参与的禀赋经济中，金融抑制对政府融资成本的均衡效应。研究表明，一系列广泛的抑制政策通过影响欧拉方程中与政府规模相关的楔子，或通过改变主体间的财政再分配发挥作用。抑制强度由一项与净政府支出正相关的政策反馈规则来刻画。当财政政策挥霍无度且货币政策具有适应性时，此类抑制政策会提升债券价值，降低无资金支持的财政扩张的通胀成本，并压低债券风险溢价。抑制并非债券持有人的免费午餐——他们虽支付较低的通胀税，但未来实际回报率也更低。当货币政策不配合财政政策时，抑制可为赤字提供临时融资，使央行在保持通胀控制力的同时，让政府债务成为对冲财政通胀的工具。

title: An Economic and Environmental Analysis of Virtual Fencing for Precision Grazing
title_zh: 精准放牧虚拟围栏的经济与环境分析
title_primary: 精准放牧虚拟围栏的经济与环境分析

authors: Elias Maritan, Karl Behrendt, Sarah Morgan, Steven Mark Rutter, James Lowenberg‐DeBoer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The UK grazing livestock sector is challenged by declining farm profitability and stringent environmental policy. Innovative technologies such as virtual fencing could enable a balanced economic and environmental performance of beef production. Virtual fencing is a livestock management tool relying on invisible boundaries perceived as auditory, electrical, or vibrational cues emitted by devices worn by grazing animals. This analysis compares virtual and conventional fencing from an economic and environmental perspective using a multi‐objective linear programming model. Optimal livestock management scenarios are identified for two typical UK cattle grazing systems. In intensive lowland beef finishing, virtual fencing achieves the lowest economic performance and a beef carbon emission intensity comparable to electric fencing. In an extensive upland suckler cow system, virtual fencing enables ecological conservation and reduces beef carbon emission intensity but increases labour input compared to set stocking. This ex‐ante assessment illustrates how precision grazing technologies can be simultaneously evaluated against economic and environmental objectives. The results indicate that, under current cost structures, virtual fencing is unlikely to be competitive with electric fencing in intensive lowland beef finishing systems, where it delivers similar environmental outcomes at higher cost. In contrast, in upland suckler cow systems, virtual fencing can support habitat protection and reduce beef carbon emission intensity but remains constrained by capital and labour costs. These findings suggest that virtual fencing is unlikely to be widely adopted on purely commercial grounds but could play a targeted role in the delivery of publicly subsidised conservation programmes such as the UK's Environmental Land Management schemes.
abstract_zh: 英国放牧畜牧业面临农场盈利能力下降和严格环境政策的双重挑战。虚拟围栏等创新技术有望实现牛肉生产的经济与环境绩效平衡。虚拟围栏是一种牲畜管理工具，依赖放牧动物佩戴设备发出的听觉、电击或振动信号所感知的隐形边界。本研究采用多目标线性规划模型，从经济与环境视角对比分析虚拟围栏与传统围栏。针对两种典型的英国牛群放牧系统，识别出最优的牲畜管理方案。在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中，虚拟围栏的经济绩效最低，牛肉碳排放强度与电围栏相当。在粗放型高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏虽能促进生态保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但相较于固定放牧增加了劳动力投入。这项事前评估展示了如何同时从经济与环境目标维度评价精准放牧技术。结果表明，在当前成本结构下，虚拟围栏在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中难以与电围栏竞争——其以更高成本实现相似环境效益。相反，在高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏可支持栖息地保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但仍受资本与劳动力成本制约。这些发现表明，虚拟围栏难以纯粹基于商业理由被广泛采用，但可在英国环境土地管理计划等公共补贴保护项目中发挥针对性作用。

abstract: We introduce consumer choice into a search-theoretic model of monetary exchange. In contrast to standard search models featuring bilateral meetings, consumers can meet multiple sellers and choose a seller with whom to trade. Market power is endogenized through competitive search and it is influenced by the degree of consumer choice. We consider the effects of greater consumer choice on both market power and the welfare cost of inflation. Surprisingly, we find that greater consumer choice can have a non-monotonic effect on market power. At lower levels of consumer choice, an increase in the degree of consumer choice tends to increase firms’ market power, while the opposite is true at higher levels. When we calibrate the model to U.S. data, we find that despite greater consumer choice having a positive effect on welfare overall, it can also amplify the negative welfare effects of inflation, making it significantly more costly.
abstract_zh: 我们将消费者选择引入货币交换的搜寻理论模型中。与标准搜寻模型中双边会面的设定不同，消费者能够接触多个卖家并选择交易对象。市场势力通过竞争性搜寻内生决定，并受消费者选择程度的影响。我们考察了更大程度的消费者选择对市场势力及通货膨胀福利成本的影响。令人意外的是，我们发现更大程度的消费者选择对市场势力的影响可能呈现非单调性。在消费者选择程度较低时，增加消费者选择程度往往提升企业的市场势力，而在较高水平时则相反。当我们将模型校准至美国数据时，发现尽管更大程度的消费者选择总体上对福利有正面影响，但它也可能放大通货膨胀的负面福利效应，使其代价显著增加。

title: An assessment of Zimbabwe's post-independence land reforms
title_zh: 津巴布韦独立后土地改革评估
title_primary: 津巴布韦独立后土地改革评估
title_secondary: An assessment of Zimbabwe's post-independence land reforms
authors: Partson Paradza
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Zimbabwe’s land reform was initiated at independence in 1980 to redress deeply unequal colonial land ownership patterns and advance socio-economic justice. However, its outcomes remain contested and unevenly understood across a fragmented body of scholarship. This study therefore undertakes a systematic review of peer-reviewed research from 1980 to 2026, examining the evolution of scholarly engagement, the policy trajectory across reform phases, and the multidimensional impacts of land reform. The review shows that while redistribution expanded access to land and reconfigured agrarian structures, its outcomes have been differentiated and conditional. Social and livelihood patterns reveal the emergence of “middle farmers” alongside the continued marginalisation of vulnerable groups, including women and youth. Environmental evidence points to both adaptive land use and persistent ecological pressures. Across phases, the effectiveness of reform has depended less on redistribution itself and more on institutional capacity, policy coherence, and post-settlement support. By integrating dispersed scholarship within a coherent analytical framework, the study demonstrates that land reform functions as a foundational but insufficient condition for agrarian transformation, with outcomes shaped by the interaction between access to land and broader governance systems.
abstract_zh: 津巴布韦的土地改革始于1980年独立之际，旨在纠正殖民时期极度不平等的土地所有权格局，并推动社会经济正义。然而，其成果在零散的研究文献中仍存争议，且理解程度参差不齐。为此，本研究对1980年至2026年间经同行评审的研究进行了系统性回顾，考察了学术参与的演变、各改革阶段的政策轨迹以及土地改革的多维影响。综述显示，尽管再分配扩大了土地获取机会并重构了农业结构，但其成果呈现出差异化和条件性特征。社会与生计模式揭示了“中等农民”群体的兴起，同时妇女和青年等弱势群体持续被边缘化。环境证据表明，既存在适应性的土地利用方式，也面临持续的生态压力。在各阶段中，改革的有效性更多取决于制度能力、政策连贯性和安置后支持，而非再分配本身。通过将分散的学术成果整合于一个连贯的分析框架内，本研究证明，土地改革是农业转型的基础性条件，但并非充分条件，其成果受土地获取机会与更广泛治理体系之间相互作用的影响。

title: Reduced strategies and cognitive hierarchies in the extensive and normal form
title_zh: 简化策略与认知层级在扩展式与标准式博弈中的表现
title_primary: 简化策略与认知层级在扩展式与标准式博弈中的表现
title_secondary: Reduced strategies and cognitive hierarchies in the extensive and normal form
authors: Pierpaolo Battigalli
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a recent paper, Lin and Palfrey (2024) developed a theory of cognitive hierarchies (CH) in sequential games and observed that this solution concept is not reduced-normal-form invariant. In this paper I qualify and explain this observation. I show that the CH model is normal-form invariant, and that the differences arising from the application of the CH model to the reduced normal form depend only on how randomization by level-0 types is modeled. Indeed, while the uniform behavior strategy in the extensive form yields the uniform mixed strategy in the normal form, the latter does not correspond to the uniform randomization in the reduced normal form, because different reduced strategies may correspond to sets of equivalent strategies with different cardinalities. I also comment on (i) the invariance of the CH model to some transformations of the sequential game, and (ii) the independence of conditional beliefs about co-players’ level-types.
abstract_zh: 在近期的一篇论文中，Lin和Palfrey（2024）提出了序贯博弈中的认知层级（CH）理论，并观察到该解概念不具备约简正规型不变性。本文对这一观察进行了限定与解释。我证明CH模型具有正规型不变性，且将CH模型应用于约简正规型时产生的差异仅取决于对0层级类型随机化的建模方式。实际上，尽管扩展型中的均匀行为策略对应于正规型中的均匀混合策略，但后者并不对应于约简正规型中的均匀随机化，因为不同的约简策略可能对应于基数不同的等价策略集合。我还就以下两点进行了评论：（i）CH模型对序贯博弈某些变换的不变性，以及（ii）关于对手层级类型的条件信念的独立性。

title: Impact of rural collective economy development on farmers’ governance of the human settlement environment in rural China
title_zh: 中国农村集体经济发展对农户人居环境治理的影响
title_primary: 中国农村集体经济发展对农户人居环境治理的影响
title_secondary: Impact of rural collective economy development on farmers’ governance of the human settlement environment in rural China
authors: Hua Lu Guan Wang Guowei Song Hao Hu a School of Digital Economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics, Nanchang, Chinab College of Economics and Management, Nanjing Agricultural University, Nanjing, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Poor rural human settlement environments (HSEs) are a persistent challenge in developing countries. While the development of the rural collective economy (RCE) is considered a potential solution in China, rigorous quantitative analysis has been lacking. This study uses a large-scale Chinese farmer survey and Mvprobit/Ivprobit models to analyse the impact and mechanisms of RCE development on farmers’ governance of HSEs. Results show that stronger RCEs significantly increase the likelihood of improved sanitation, specifically, scientific sewage treatment and sanitary toilet adoption – a finding robust to endogeneity concerns and after controlling for rural tourism, poverty status, and suburban location. RCE growth boosts rural public spending and farmers’ disposable income, offsetting inadequate government funding, and enhances farmer satisfaction with village cadres, fostering collective action. Village cadre human capital and the farmer dependency ratio significantly moderate these effects. Promoting RCE development, and engaging migrant workers are key strategies for improving rural sanitation.
abstract_zh: 农村人居环境恶劣是发展中国家面临的持续挑战。尽管在中国，发展农村集体经济被视为一种潜在解决方案，但缺乏严谨的定量分析。本研究利用大规模中国农民调查数据及Mvprobit/Ivprobit模型，分析农村集体经济发展对农民治理人居环境的影响及其作用机制。结果表明，较强的农村集体经济显著提升了卫生条件改善的可能性，具体表现为科学污水处理和卫生厕所的采用——这一发现在控制内生性问题及排除乡村旅游、贫困状态和郊区区位等因素后依然稳健。农村集体经济增长促进了农村公共支出和农民可支配收入的增加，弥补了政府资金不足，并增强了农民对村干部的满意度，从而推动集体行动。村干部人力资本和农民抚养比显著调节了这些效应。促进农村集体经济发展及吸纳农民工参与，是改善农村卫生状况的关键策略。
